exposure: Hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN)
Other red blood cell alloimmunization (e.g., Kell, Duffy)
finding: The live birth prevalence of HDFN was higher than previously reported, with Rh-induced HDFN prevalence remaining similar, and HDFN was associated with increased healthcare utilization and adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Newborns affected by HDFN caused by Rh alloimmunization were more likely to require cesarean delivery.
